title: Cloud Architect
description: Learn cloud fundamentals, architecture patterns, networking, security, reliability, cost, and migration planning.

tree.name: Cloud Fundamentals
tree.description: Understand compute, storage, networking, identity, regions, availability zones, pricing, and shared responsibility.

children.name: Compute and Storage
children.description: Compare VMs, containers, serverless, object storage, block storage, managed databases, and backups.

children.name: Identity and Access
children.description: Design least-privilege roles, policies, service accounts, secrets, and account boundaries.

tree.name: Networking and Security
tree.description: Design secure connectivity across VPCs, subnets, load balancers, DNS, firewalls, and private services.

children.name: VPC Design
children.description: Plan CIDR ranges, public/private subnets, gateways, routing, peering, and hybrid connectivity.

children.name: Security Controls
children.description: Apply encryption, key management, logging, vulnerability management, and threat detection.

children.name: Practice: Architecture Tradeoff Review
children.description: Compare two cloud designs on security, cost, reliability, operations, and migration risk.

tree.name: Reliability, Performance, and Cost
tree.description: Create resilient architectures with observability, scaling, backups, disaster recovery, and cost discipline.

children.name: High Availability and DR
children.description: Design multi-AZ systems, backups, recovery objectives, failover, queues, and graceful degradation.

children.name: Cost Optimization
children.description: Estimate costs, right-size resources, use budgets, detect waste, and explain tradeoffs.

tree.name: Architecture Practice
tree.description: Turn requirements into diagrams, decisions, migrations, governance, and stakeholder-ready architecture docs.

resources.title: AWS Solutions Architect Associate Full Course (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Infrastructure as Code
children.description: Model environments with Terraform or native templates, modules, state, reviews, and policy checks.

children.name: Architecture Reviews and ADRs
children.description: Run design reviews, document tradeoffs, validate assumptions, and write architecture decision records.

children.name: Project: Architecture Blueprint
children.description: Design a secure, scalable product architecture with diagrams, IaC skeleton, cost estimate, and DR plan.
